info.title: catalog-api
info.description: Catalog operations, daily target ranges, the day plan and meal log, and Owner sign-in for the single Owner. Access control is password login with a server-side session per ADR-004 option d. Nutrient values are per 100 g.

post.summary: Recognise a label photo and save the product when all required values are known. The photo is never stored by the app.

photo.description: Label photo, held in memory for this request only.

400.description: Error photo.unreadable. The photo cannot be processed.

409.description: Error product.duplicate_name_shop. A selectable product has the same name and shop (R-003). Nothing is saved.

422.description: Error product.values_missing. One or more of name, shop, calories, protein, fat were not recognised. Nothing is saved. The body lists the missing fields and the recognised values so the client can call createProduct.

502.description: Error recognition.unavailable. The recognition provider failed.

get.summary: List products, ordered by name then shop ignoring letter case, not paginated. With state selectable (the default) it returns the products that can be chosen for new plans and log entries: not soft-deleted and not replaced by a newer version (R-004, R-006). With state deleted it returns the soft-deleted products so they can be restored. Replaced versions are never listed; read one with getProduct.

post.summary: Save a product from supplied values, including a product added by hand (source manual). Enforces R-002 and R-003.

400.description: Error product.value_invalid. A supplied numeric value is negative. Nothing is saved. The body lists the offending fields. A value of 0 is not an error.

get.summary: Read one product by id in any state: selectable, replaced by a newer version, or soft-deleted. Past records use this to show the product they were made with (R-004, R-006). A product is never removed and its id is never reused.

patch.summary: Edit a selectable product. A change to any of calories, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, salt or piece_weight records a new product with the edited values and leaves the old one unchanged and no longer selectable (R-004); the response is 201, versioned true, and product.id is the new id. A change to only name, brand, shop, portion_size or portion_calories is applied in place (R-005); the response is 200, versioned false, same id. A request that changes no value records nothing and returns 200 with versioned false. A change that would give two selectable products the same name and shop, ignoring letter case and extra spaces, is refused and nothing is saved (R-003).

200.description: Edited in place, or nothing changed.

400.description: Error product.value_invalid when a supplied numeric value is negative, with the offending fields; or error request.invalid when the body is empty or names a field that cannot be edited. Nothing is saved.

409.description: Error product.duplicate_name_shop (R-003), or error product.not_selectable when the product is soft-deleted or already replaced by a newer version. Nothing is saved.

422.description: Error product.values_missing (R-002). A required value was set to null or blank.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a product (R-006). It stays readable by id and in past records, and is no longer selectable. Deleting a product that is already soft-deleted returns it unchanged.

409.description: Error product.not_selectable. The product was replaced by a newer version. Nothing is changed.

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted product with its values unchanged (R-006). Past records are unchanged. Restoring a product that is already selectable returns it unchanged.

409.description: Error product.duplicate_name_shop when a selectable product has the same name and shop (R-003, R-006); the product stays soft-deleted. Error product.not_selectable when the product was replaced by a newer version.

get.summary: List dishes, ordered by name ignoring letter case, then by id, not paginated. With state selectable (the default) it returns the dishes that can be chosen for new plans and log entries: not soft-deleted and not replaced by a newer version (R-008, R-010). With state deleted it returns the soft-deleted dishes so they can be restored. Replaced versions are never listed; read one with getDish.

post.summary: Save a dish with a name and at least one line (R-007). Each line is a product id with grams or with pieces. Pieces are accepted only for a product with a piece weight. Every product must be selectable (ADR-014). Duplicate dish names are allowed (R-010). Nothing is saved when any check fails.

400.description: Error dish.line_invalid. One or more lines are refused; the body lists each by index with a reason. Nothing is saved.

422.description: Error dish.values_missing. The name is missing or blank, or there is no line. The body lists what is missing.

get.summary: Read one dish by id in any state: selectable, replaced by a newer version, or soft-deleted. Past plans and log entries use this to show the dish they were made with (R-008, R-010). A dish is never removed and its id is never reused. Each line shows its product by the exact product id saved, in whatever state (R-009), and the weight of the line.

patch.summary: Edit a selectable dish. A change to lines (products, amounts or their order) records a new dish with the given lines and leaves the old one unchanged and no longer selectable (R-008); the response is 201, versioned true, and dish.id is the new id. A change to only the name is applied in place (ADR-013 option a); the response is 200, versioned false, same id. A request that changes nothing records nothing and returns 200 with versioned false. A new line or a line with a changed product must reference a selectable product; a line whose product id is already in the dish is carried over without that check (ADR-014 option a).

200.description: Edited in place, or nothing changed.

400.description: Error dish.line_invalid, with the refused lines; or error request.invalid when the body is empty or names a field that cannot be edited. Nothing is saved.

409.description: Error dish.not_selectable. The dish is soft-deleted or already replaced by a newer version. Nothing is saved.

422.description: Error dish.values_missing. The name was set to blank or the lines were set to none.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a dish (R-010). It stays readable by id and in past records, and is no longer selectable. Deleting a dish that is already soft-deleted returns it unchanged.

409.description: Error dish.not_selectable. The dish was replaced by a newer version. Nothing is changed.

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted dish with its lines unchanged (R-010). Past records are unchanged. Restoring a dish that is already selectable returns it unchanged.

409.description: Error dish.not_selectable. The dish was replaced by a newer version. Nothing is changed.

get.summary: Read the daily target ranges in force today for calories, protein and fat, and whether setup is complete. A nutrient with no range yet is null. Today is the date of the server clock in the Owner time zone (ADR-016). While setup_complete is false the client shows the first-use setup before anything else (REQ-009/AC-001).

Read the ranges in force on a calendar date, for the journal: for each nutrient, the range with the latest effective date on or before that date, or null when none had been saved by then. A change saved on day D applies from D, so the answer for D and later dates changes and the answer for earlier dates does not (REQ-009/AC-005, AC-006). A date after today answers like today, because no future-dated change exists. The answer follows later saves and does not freeze a closed day: closing a day must store the ranges it used (ADR-015/C-004, REQ-009/AC-011).

200.description: The ranges in force on the date. as_of is that date.

400.description: Error request.invalid. The date is not a valid calendar date.

put.summary: Set or change the range of one nutrient, effective from today in the Owner time zone (ADR-016). Today and later days use the new range; earlier days keep theirs (REQ-009/AC-005, AC-006). The three ranges are saved one at a time. Both limits are required, each a whole number from 0 upward, and the minimum may not be above the maximum; equal is allowed (R-011). When a save is refused nothing is saved and the previous range stays in force. The effective date is always today: any date or weekday field in the body is ignored, so no day-specific range can be set (REQ-009/AC-007). Only calories, protein and fat can be set (REQ-009/AC-008).

200.description: Saved. The range is in force from effective_from, which is today.

400.description: Error target.value_invalid when a limit is negative, not a whole number or above the supported maximum, or error target.range_inverted when the minimum is above the maximum. The body lists the offending limits in invalid. Nothing is saved.

404.description: Error target.nutrient_unknown. Only calories, protein and fat have a range. Nothing is saved.

422.description: Error target.values_missing. The minimum or the maximum is missing or null. The body lists what is missing. Nothing is saved.

get.summary: Read the plan of one day by meal (breakfast, brunch, lunch, afternoon_snack, dinner), for any valid date. Each entry shows its product or dish by the exact id saved, in whatever state (R-009, ADR-014). today is the server date in the Owner time zone (ADR-016). editable is true only for today and the next day while the day is open (R-013).

200.description: The plan of the day. has_plan of each meal is true when it has plan entries.

post.summary: Add an entry to a meal of the plan of today or the next day (R-013, REQ-013/AC-004). A product takes grams or pieces, a whole dish takes no amount (R-007). Checks run in this order: date and body, day window, day open, then the entry. Nothing is saved when a check fails.

patch.summary: Change the amount of a product entry of the plan, in grams or in pieces. The product or dish and the meal never change; to change them remove the entry and add another. A dish entry has no amount (entry.invalid, reason amount_on_dish). An entry whose product was replaced or deleted can still change its amount.

delete.summary: Remove an entry from the plan of today or the next day. Other entries keep their order.

get.summary: Read the log of one day by meal, for any valid date. has_plan of each meal is true when the plan of that day has entries for it, so the client shows confirm as planned only for those meals (REQ-014/AC-013). Entries show their product or dish by the exact id saved, in whatever state (R-009). editable is true while the day is open and not after today.

post.summary: Add an entry to a meal of the log of an open day that is not after today. A product takes grams or pieces, a whole dish takes no amount (R-007). The entry belongs to the meal given, whatever the plan says (REQ-014/AC-007). No limit or warning is applied relative to the plan or any total (REQ-014/AC-006). Checks run in this order: date and body, day window, day open, then the entry.

Log a selectable dish as separate product entries in one meal, optionally with other amounts (REQ-014/AC-005, AC-010; ADR-018). Each dish line becomes one product entry with that line's exact product id, even when the product was replaced or deleted, and from_dish_id set to the dish. lines overrides amounts by line position; a position not listed keeps the dish amount. The catalog dish is never changed (REQ-006/AC-007). All entries are saved or none.

201.description: Saved, in the order of the dish lines.

patch.summary: Change the amount of a product entry of the log of an open day, in grams or in pieces (REQ-014/AC-002). The product or dish and the meal never change. A dish entry has no amount (entry.invalid, reason amount_on_dish). The plan is never changed.

delete.summary: Remove an entry from the log of an open day.

post.summary: Copy the plan entries of this day and meal into the log of the same day and meal, same products, dishes and amounts, in plan order (REQ-014/AC-001). The plan is not changed. To load the plan as actual and edit it (REQ-014/AC-002), call this and then changeLogEntry or removeLogEntry on the copies.

409.description: Error plan.meal_empty when the plan of this day has no entry for the meal, error log.meal_not_empty when the log of the meal already has entries, or error day.closed. Nothing is saved.

post.summary: Close a day on the Owner's confirmation: today, an open past day, or a day with no entries, from the first day of use through today (REQ-011/AC-001, AC-008, AC-010). Never automatic. One transaction locks the day, sets closed_at and stores the ranges in force on that date (ADR-020). Other days are untouched (REQ-016/AC-006). No reopen: a closed day is refused with day.closed (REQ-016/AC-002). Checks: date, close window, day open.

200.description: Closed. The log sheet of the day.

get.summary: Open days before a date, oldest first, for the close reminder (REQ-011/AC-004, AC-006, AC-012, AC-013). A day with no entries is open until closed. Runs from the first day of use to the day before the date, not after today (REQ-011/AC-011). Never blocks planning (R-013).

200.description: The open days; empty when none.

get.summary: Days newest first, from the day before the before date (default tomorrow, so today first) back to the first day of use, open and closed, empty days included (REQ-016/AC-001, AC-004, AC-005). Page with next_before.
Report whether the backend, its database and the label reader are reachable. Used by test and deployment checks.

503.description: Error not.ready. At least one dependency is unreachable.

post.summary: Sign in with the Owner password. On success a session row is created and the owner_session cookie is set (ADR-004/C-007). Failed attempts are throttled (ADR-004/C-008).

204.description: Signed in. Set-Cookie owner_session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict).

401.description: Error auth.failed. The password is wrong. The response is the same whatever the cause.

429.description: Error auth.throttled. Too many failed attempts; try again later.

post.summary: End the Owner session, delete its session row and clear the cookie.

ownerSession.name: owner_session
ownerSession.description: Opaque session id in an HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie, issued by loginOwner after a correct password and checked against a session row with an expiry (ADR-004).

RunId.name: X-Run-Id
RunId.description: Correlation id echoed in logs and responses.

ProductId.name: id
ProductId.description: Product id. Every version of a product has its own id, which never changes and is never reused.

DishId.name: id
DishId.description: Dish id. Every version of a dish has its own id, which never changes and is never reused.

TargetNutrient.name: nutrient
TargetNutrient.description: The nutrient whose range is set. Any other value is answered with target.nutrient_unknown.

TargetDate.name: date
TargetDate.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the Owner time zone (ADR-016).

EntryId.name: entryId
EntryId.description: Entry id, generated by the server and never reused. An id of the plan is not found in the log and the other way round.

Unauthorized.description: Error auth.required. No valid Owner session.

NotFound.description: Error product.not_found. No product has this id.

DishNotFound.description: Error dish.not_found. No dish has this id.

BadRequest.description: Error request.invalid. The date or meal is not valid, or the body is empty or has a field that is not allowed. Nothing is saved.

EntryInvalid.description: Error entry.invalid with reasons, and for addLogDishProducts the refused lines by index; or error request.invalid. Nothing is saved.

EntryNotFound.description: Error entry.not_found. No entry of this kind has this id on this day.

DayClosed.description: Error day.closed. The day is closed and never changes (R-013, REQ-013/AC-007, REQ-014/AC-011). Nothing is changed.

PlanOutOfRange.description: Error plan.day_out_of_range. Only today and the next day can be planned (R-013, REQ-013/AC-004). Nothing is changed.

LogOutOfRange.description: Error log.day_out_of_range. A day after today cannot be logged. Nothing is changed.

CloseOutOfRange.description: Error close.day_out_of_range. After today or before the first day of use. Nothing is changed.

password.description: The Owner password. Never logged or returned.

carbohydrate.description: Optional. Per 100 g. A 100 ml label value is sent as the same number (100 ml = 100 g).

salt.description: Optional. Per 100 g. Sodium is computed from it (R-001).

portion_size.description: Optional portion example size. Independent of portion_calories; either may be given alone. 0 is stored as empty.

portion_calories.description: Optional. Calories of the portion example. Independent of portion_size; either may be given alone. 0 is stored as empty.

piece_weight.description: Optional average weight of one piece. When present and above 0 the product is counted by the piece (R-003). 0 is stored as empty, so the product is not counted by the piece.

ProductUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their value. Optional fields accept null to clear them. Required fields (name, shop, calories, protein, fat) cannot be null or blank. The source cannot be edited.

portion_size.description: Portion example size. 0 is stored as empty.

portion_calories.description: Calories of the portion example. 0 is stored as empty.

piece_weight.description: Average weight of one piece. 0 is stored as empty.

sodium.description: Per 100 g. Computed on read as salt x 400; 0 when salt is empty (R-001). Never entered; a value sent in a request is ignored.

counted_by_piece.description: True when a piece weight is stored (R-003). Derived, never stored; a value sent in a request is ignored.

replaced_by.description: Id of the newer version that replaced this product after a nutrient edit (R-004), or null. A product with a value here is never selectable and never changes again.

deleted.description: True when the product is soft-deleted (R-006).

selectable.description: True when the product is neither soft-deleted nor replaced, so it can be chosen for new plans and log entries. Derived, never stored.

versioned.description: True when a new product was recorded; product.id is then the new id the client must use from now on.

replaced_id.description: Id of the product that was replaced, or null when the edit was applied in place or changed nothing.

DishLineInput.description: One line of a dish: a product id and exactly one amount, grams or pieces. The amount must be above 0. Pieces are accepted only for a product with a piece weight (R-007).

product_id.description: The exact product id. It is kept as given and never changed to a newer version of the product (R-009).

pieces.description: Amount in pieces. Weight is pieces times the product piece_weight.

lines.description: The lines in display order. At least one is required; an empty list is answered with dish.values_missing.

DishUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their value. When lines is given it replaces all lines of the dish.

lines.description: The full new list of lines in display order. Cannot be empty.

grams.description: The saved amount when given in grams, otherwise null.

pieces.description: The saved amount when given in pieces, otherwise null.

weight_grams.description: Grams as saved, or pieces times the piece_weight of this exact product id (REQ-006/AC-002). Computed on read, never stored.

total_weight_grams.description: Sum of the line weights. Computed on read.

replaced_by.description: Id of the newer version that replaced this dish after an edit of lines (R-008), or null. A dish with a value here is never selectable and its lines never change again.

deleted.description: True when the dish is soft-deleted (R-010).

selectable.description: True when the dish is neither soft-deleted nor replaced, so it can be chosen for new plans and log entries. Derived, never stored.

has_unselectable_product.description: True when at least one line product is replaced or soft-deleted (R-009). The line keeps that exact product. Derived, never stored.

versioned.description: True when a new dish was recorded; dish.id is then the new id the client must use from now on.

replaced_id.description: Id of the dish that was replaced, or null when the edit was applied in place or changed nothing.

TargetRangeInput.description: The new range of one nutrient. Both limits are needed to save; a missing or null limit is answered with target.values_missing. Fields other than minimum and maximum are ignored.

minimum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat
minimum.description: Lowest accepted daily total, inclusive. A whole number from 0 upward. A negative or fractional value is answered with target.value_invalid.

maximum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat
maximum.description: Highest accepted daily total, inclusive. A whole number from 0 upward, not below the minimum. Equal to the minimum is allowed.

minimum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat

maximum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat

unit.description: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat.

effective_from.description: The calendar date from which this range applies, in the Owner time zone. Set by the server to the day of the save; never sent.

as_of.description: The date the ranges are in force on: today for getTargetRanges, the requested date for getTargetRangesOn.

setup_complete.description: True when calories, protein and fat each have a range in force on as_of.

calories.description: The calories range, or null when none was saved by as_of.

protein.description: The protein range, or null when none was saved by as_of.

fat.description: The fat range, or null when none was saved by as_of.

Meal.description: The five meals of a day, in day order.

NewEntry.description: One entry to add: a meal and either a product with an amount, or a whole dish. A product needs exactly one of grams and pieces, each a whole number above 0, otherwise entry.invalid (amount_missing or amount_invalid); pieces only for a product with a piece weight (piece_without_weight, R-007). A dish is a whole portion and takes no amount (amount_on_dish, R-007). Exactly one of product_id and dish_id is needed (subject_missing). The exact id is kept for life (R-009).

product_id.description: The exact id of a selectable product.

grams.description: Amount in whole grams, 1 or more. 150.5 is refused with amount_invalid (REQ-013/AC-006).

pieces.description: Amount in whole pieces, 1 or more. Weight is pieces times the piece_weight of the product.

dish_id.description: The exact id of a selectable dish, planned or logged as a whole portion.

EntryChange.description: The new amount of a product entry: exactly one of grams and pieces, whole and 1 or more. The rules of NewEntry apply to it.

pieces.description: New amount in whole pieces. Needs a piece weight on the product of the entry.

product.description: The exact product of a product entry, in any state, or null for a dish entry.

dish.description: The exact dish of a dish entry, in any state, with its lines, or null for a product entry.

grams.description: The saved amount when given in grams, otherwise null.

pieces.description: The saved amount when given in pieces, otherwise null.

from_dish_id.description: The dish a product entry was split from by addLogDishProducts, otherwise null. Informational only (ADR-018).

weight_grams.description: Grams, or pieces times the piece_weight of the exact product id (REQ-014/AC-008); for a dish entry, total_weight_grams of the dish. Computed on read, never stored.

DishProductsInput.description: A selectable dish to log as separate product entries in one meal, with optional amount overrides by line position.

lines.description: Overrides. A position not in the dish is refused with line_unknown; a position not listed keeps the dish amount.

MealTotals.description: Whole-number totals of one meal (ADR-021). No range, colour or plan-versus-actual difference (REQ-010/AC-013, REQ-015/AC-010).

has_plan.description: True when the plan of this day has entries for the meal.

total.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat
total.description: Rounded once to a whole number; the range check and number use it (REQ-010/AC-025).

minimum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat
minimum.description: Inclusive; null when no range was in force.

maximum.x-unit: kcal for calories, g for protein and fat
maximum.description: Inclusive; null when no range was in force.

status.description: green from minimum to maximum inclusive, yellow below, red above (R-012); no_range when no range was in force.

signed_number.description: Below the minimum: minus and the amount to the minimum. Above the maximum: plus and the amount over it. Inside: minus and the distance to the maximum, 0 at the maximum (R-012). null for no_range.

DayResult.description: Day totals of a log or plan against the ranges, open or closed alike (REQ-010/AC-010, AC-023). A total sums the unrounded entry values, normalised to 6 decimals, then Math.round once, halves up (ADR-021, REQ-010/AC-012). A plan is never added to a log total (REQ-010/AC-007). No warning is given (REQ-015/AC-011).

ranges_source.description: closed_copy: the ranges stored at closing, never recomputed (ADR-015/C-004, REQ-010/AC-014). in_force: the ranges in force on the date.

nutrients.description: Calories, protein and fat, in that order.

today.description: Today in the Owner time zone (ADR-016).

closed.description: True when the day is closed by closeDay (ADR-019, ADR-020). A closed day is never reopened.

closed_at.description: Null while the day is open.

editable.description: True when entries of this kind can be changed now: the day is open and, for a plan, is today or the next day, or, for a log, is not after today.

meals.description: All five meals in day order, with an empty entries list for a meal without entries.

first_day_of_use.description: Earliest date with a saved range or day record, at most today; null when none (A-042).

open_past.description: Before today and not closed (REQ-016/AC-004); false for a closed day (AC-005).

next_before.description: The before value of the next page; null at the first day of use.

invalid.description: Fields whose supplied value is negative.
The limits that are refused. For target.range_inverted both minimum and maximum are listed.

recognised.description: Values recognised so far, per 100 g; the client resends them with the supplied ones to createProduct.

lines.description: The refused lines, by zero-based index in the request.

reasons.description: Present for entry.invalid: why the entry was refused. subject_missing: not exactly one of product_id and dish_id. amount_missing: a product without exactly one of grams and pieces. amount_on_dish: an amount on a dish entry. amount_invalid: not a whole number of 1 or more. piece_without_weight: pieces for a product with no piece weight (R-007). The others name an id that is not found or not selectable.

lines.description: For addLogDishProducts: the refused lines, by zero-based index into the lines of the request, or by dish line position for a carried line.
